title: Safely managed sanitation, Eastern and South-eastern Asia
headline: Since 2000, safely managed sanitation in Eastern and South-eastern Asia has risen 44.3 points
subtitle: Proportion of population using an improved sanitation facility that is not shared with other households, from which excreta are safely disposed of in situ or removed and treated off-site
years: From 19.8% in 2000 to 64.1% in 2024: 1.8 points a year.
data_line: Data: WHO/UNICEF JMP via UN SDG Global Database, series SH_SAN_SAFE, extracted 4 Nov 2026
flags: replacement series: JP, 4 Nov 2026: the safely managed drinking water series for the region drops from 76.5 (2014) to 65.0 (2015) and jumps 70.6 to 75.3 in 2024, a break in the published aggregate, so its trend and pace banners were rejected; sanitation for the same region, same custodian, has a continuous series.
